stem: What is one ongoing result of the New Deal?

options.label: F
options.text: The federal government funds a space-exploration program.

options.label: G
options.text: State governments deny residency to persons working in other states.

options.label: H
options.text: State governments use property taxes to fund social security programs.

options.label: J
options.text: People can rely more on the federal government during times of economic distress.
